blocks.html:
This method manages the inventory levels of an inventory item. It sends a request to the
[Manage Inventory Levels](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#inventory-items\_postinventoryitemsidlocationlevelsbatch)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The inventory levels to create or delete.

children.name: update
children.description: A list of inventory levels to update.

children.name: location_id
children.description: The ID of the associated stock location.

children.name: stocked_quantity
children.description:
The associated inventory item's stocked quantity in the
associated stock location.

children.name: incoming_quantity
children.description:
The associated inventory item's incoming quantity in the
associated stock location.

children.name: id
children.description: The ID of the inventory level to update.

children.name: delete
children.description:
A list of location IDs to
delete their associated inventory
levels of the inventory item.

children.name: force
children.description:
Whether to force the deletion of the inventory levels,
even if the location has stocked quantity.

types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the inventory item.
